change_summary: Added `TREND_COMMODITIES_TARGET_ATR_MULT = 7.0`, retargeted only enriched `trend_long` signals whose sector is `Commodities`, added sleeve-specific target-width attribution, and added a unit test proving Commodities trend is retargeted while Commodities breakout remains on the normal target path.

delta_metrics.gate4_basis: Accepted because EV improved in two non-overlapping windows and was null in the third, late_strong Sharpe improved by 0.31, total return improved in two windows, and max drawdown did not worsen.

hypothesis: After the accepted Technology trend target-width repair, the next unblocked exit alpha may be another selective winner-truncation pocket. Commodity trend exposure has repeatedly shown useful convexity, so widening only `trend_long | Commodities` targets should improve EV without repeating the rejected Commodity trend de-risking or broad trend target-widening families.

llm_metrics.blocker_relation: LLM soft ranking remains blocked by candidate-level replay coverage, so this run used deterministic exit alpha instead of LLM ranking.

market_regime_summary.late_strong: slow-melt bull with commodity trend winners
market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull where commodity trend still carried convexity
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak tape with no realized change from this sleeve

next_retry_requires: Do not generalize this into all trend targets; broad trend target widening remains rejected
Do not convert this into Commodity trend de-risking; that family was rejected and this result points in the opposite direction
Future exit work should use a fresh winner-truncation audit outside Technology trend and Commodity trend
notes: This was alpha_search. It changes one independent causal variable: Commodity trend target width. It deliberately avoids LLM soft-ranking because replay coverage is still insufficient, and it does not treat LLM as the problem.
